title: Evidence of copper (nano)formulation biotransformations triggered by Botrytis cinerea on grapevine leaves for targeted plant protection
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, 13,1485-1498
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN01102G, Paper

Diana Salvador, Sónia Rodrigues, Artur Alves, Cátia Fidalgo, Sandra Rodrigues, Hiram Castillo-Michel, Astrid Avellan
The present work aimed at unravelling if fungal inoculation on grapevine leaves could trigger the dissolution of foliarly deposited Cu (nano)formulations, and how this would impact Cu translocation in planta.
